verdict.rationale: Scheduling jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions Slurm, Kubernetes, or any managed cluster scheduler. Paperspace's documented offerings are VMs (Machines), Jupyter Notebooks, container Deployments and ML Workflows. These are adjacent features, not a managed Slurm or Kubernetes job scheduler.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
